# Cache Meter (Claude Code Mod)

> Cache Meter, a Claude Code mod – keep your prompt cache warm through a break with /keepwarm and see when it is about to expire. A Claude Code mod (a Claude Code plugin whose TypeScript hooks run inside Claude Code) that shows the prompt cache and token usage: a countdown until the cache expires, the hit rate of each request, context fill and auto-compact point above the prompt; the session's cost at API prices and a line under each answer with what it cost; a note at a model switch and before any request that splits a warm cache; an optional notification before the cache expires and an optional session budget; a /tokens pane with three tabs – Overview (per-request chart, what caching saved, totals, auto-compact and plan-limit forecasts, cold rewrites), Context (which tool results, memory files, MCP servers – with calls per server – and skills fill the context) and Health (rates, unusual stops, API errors, server-side tool calls, warm misses with their cause, per-subagent use, Claude Code's cache verdict); /tokens report to copy a Markdown summary; and /keepwarm to keep the cache warm. Install: `claude plugin install cache-meter --marketplace florian101010/cache-meter`. Test: `claude plugin validate --strict . && claude plugin test .`. Requires Claude Code ≥ 2.1.287. MIT.
